state.instructions: Find a red t-shirt. Use the filters of this list to narrow it to the item that the task asks for. If the filter for a feature that the task names (such as a colour, but not the kind of item) is closed, click it to open it. If it is open, click the value that matches the item. If the filter you need is not in view (a long side bar goes on below), scroll down once instead. Then stop.

__tool__.instructions: Which action best advances `instructions`, given `state` and `previous_actions`?

criteria.locate: Points at the element on the enlarged picture of a part of the web page, which is the picture in `state.zoom`.

locate.target.instructions: the element that `instructions` say to click next, in `state.zoom`

locate.target?present.instructions: Is the element that `instructions` say to click next visible in `state.zoom`?
